title: Build exports in a cron job
chosen: A cron job, jobs/build_exports.py, builds pending exports every minute, like the outbox job.

rejected.option: Build the CSV in the request
rejected.why: A 500-order export may pass the website's 10 s request timeout.
A new service to run and pay for, against RQ4.

drawback: Exports wait up to a minute before the job picks them up.

title: Serve exports through the API behind the session cookie
chosen: The CSV stays on the VPS; GET /v1/account/export/<token> serves it to its owner only, for 7 days; the job deletes older files.

rejected.option: Public link on the static website
rejected.why: Anyone with the link gets the customer's data, forever (finding F1).
MailRelay limits attachments to 5 MB, and the email itself can be forwarded.

drawback: A download endpoint and file clean-up to maintain on the VPS.
